en_title: Sega Pulls Disastrous Total War: Shogun 2 Remaster From Sale Following Backlash
cn_title: 《全面战争》世嘉下架《幕府将军2》重制版
subtitle: 升级未达预期
opus_summary: 世嘉与Creative Assembly因质量争议下架《全面战争：幕府将军2》完全版，并将恢复原版销售。双方正调查问题并推进改进，已购玩家仍可继续游玩。

paragraphs.en: Creative Assembly and Sega have pulled Total War: Shogun 2 — Complete Edition from Steam after a raft of complaints about the quality of the remaster.
paragraphs.cn: 《全面战争：幕府将军2》完全版的重制质量遭到大量投诉后，Creative Assembly与世嘉已将这款游戏从Steam下架。

paragraphs.en: Released on October 13, this facelift for the much-loved 2011 strategy classic should have been a slam dunk for Creative Assembly. Sega had trumpeted "upgraded visuals," which include "improved textures, models, lighting, shadows, fog and environments, alongside modern rendering, anti-aliasing and upscaling options." The game also has optional 2.5D campaign movies inspired by Japanese Ukiyo-e art.
paragraphs.cn: 这款重制版于10月13日推出，为备受喜爱的2011年经典策略游戏翻新画面，对Creative Assembly来说本应是十拿九稳的事。世嘉此前大力宣传游戏「升级后的视觉效果」，包括「改进的纹理、模型、光照、阴影、雾效与环境，以及现代渲染、抗锯齿和分辨率放大选项」。游戏还提供可选的2.5D战役动画，灵感来自日本浮世绘艺术。

paragraphs.en: But fans quickly noticed art inconsistencies that some alleged were evidence of low quality AI use. In one image, a samurai’s face was replaced with a metallic texture that struggled to distinguish between the face and helmet. Fans also pointed out inconsistencies on the new storyboard cutscenes.
paragraphs.cn: 但玩家很快发现美术画面存在不协调之处，部分玩家认为，这些问题表明游戏使用了效果低劣的AI处理。其中一张画面里的武士面部变成了金属纹理，脸与头盔几乎混在一起。玩家还指出，新增的分镜式过场动画也存在不协调的问题。

paragraphs.en: The "Complete Edition" release of Shogun 2 Total War was so badly received that it might be pulled from sale on Steam.
paragraphs.cn: 《全面战争：幕府将军2》「完全版」反响极差，甚至可能会从Steam下架。

paragraphs.en: Over the years I've had many Japan-loving international students who played the original game, but the "upgrade" has bugs and what looks like bad AI upscaling. https://t.co/4S9XEpUWBY
paragraphs.cn: 这些年来，我教过许多喜爱日本文化的国际学生，他们都玩过原版游戏。但这次「升级」不仅有错误，还出现了看起来像是劣质AI放大处理造成的问题。https://t.co/4S9XEpUWBY

paragraphs.en: Compounding the issue was the fact that Sega pulled the original Shogun 2 from sale, forcing customers to buy the new Complete Edition instead if they wanted to play. The original game was often on sale for a few dollars, while this remaster was priced $40.
paragraphs.cn: 更糟的是，世嘉还停售了原版《全面战争：幕府将军2》，想玩的消费者只能购买新的完全版。原版游戏打折时往往只卖几美元，而这款重制版的售价为40美元(约合人民币268元)。

paragraphs.en: Total War: Shogun 2 — Complete Edition currently sits on an “overwhelmingly negative” user review rating on Steam, as customers who paid $10 to “upgrade” the game aired their grievances.
paragraphs.cn: 《全面战争：幕府将军2》完全版目前在Steam上的用户评价为「差评如潮」，花了10美元(约合人民币67元)「升级」游戏的玩家纷纷表达不满。

paragraphs.en: “We’re aware that Total War: Shogun 2 – Complete Edition has fallen short of both your expectations and our own standards,” Creative Assembly and Sega said in a joint statement. “We’ve seen your feedback, comments, and reviews. We agree that the current experience is not where it needs to be.
paragraphs.cn: Creative Assembly与世嘉在联合声明中表示：「我们知道，《全面战争：幕府将军2》完全版既没有达到各位的期待，也未达到我们自己的标准。我们看到了大家的反馈、评论和评测。我们也认同，目前的游戏体验尚未达标。」

paragraphs.en: “As a result we are working with platform holders to remove the game from sale and to reinstate the original game while we investigate the issues. Existing owners will still be able to access and play the game.
paragraphs.cn: 「因此，我们正与平台方合作，下架这款游戏并恢复原版销售，同时调查这些问题。已经拥有游戏的玩家仍可访问并游玩。」

paragraphs.en: “We are working closely with our development partner to identify the causes of these problems, deliver improvements, and ensure Shogun 2 – Complete Edition meets the quality standards players expect from Total War.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我们正与开发合作伙伴密切协作，查明这些问题的原因并落实改进，确保《全面战争：幕府将军2》完全版达到玩家对《全面战争》系列期待的质量标准。」

paragraphs.en: The wording of the statement shines a light on Polish co-development studio Mataboo, which has worked on everything from The Blood of Dawnwalker to Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League. Upcoming Creative Assembly games include the hotly anticipated Total War: Warhammer 40,000 and Alien Isolation 2.
paragraphs.cn: 声明中的措辞将目光引向了波兰协作开发工作室Mataboo。该工作室参与过多款游戏的开发，从《黎明行者之血》到《自杀小队：杀死正义联盟》都有其身影。Creative Assembly即将推出的游戏包括备受期待的《全面战争：战锤40K》和《异形：隔离2》。
